title: Add unhandledRejection/uncaughtException process handlers
description:
**Source:** Internal audit Sprint 60 (2026-07-11) finding P0-003

`MineflayerAdapter/index.js` has no `process.on('unhandledRejection')` or `process.on('uncaughtException')` handlers. Node.js 22+ terminates the process on unhandled rejections. Any async error in the adapter (Promise rejection inside an action handler, pathfinder timeout, bot.chat() failure) will crash the bot process without diagnostic logging.

**Recommendation:** Add both process-level handlers at module init time. Log structured diagnostics and emit a `processCrash` or `adapterError` event to the C# side before the process terminates. Make the uncaughtException handler optional terminate (allow C# to decide) via the existing handshake protocol.
